tenderSchedule.title: Short term Tender for Appointment of Transport Contractor for the export of Indelible Ink for SUVA FIJI
tenderSchedule.description: Short term Tender for Appointment of Transport Contractor for the export of Indelible Ink for SUVA FIJI for the Year 2026-27.

tenderEligibilityCriterionList.description: Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by Government of Karnataka

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.

The bidder is required to ensure browser compatibility of the computer well in advance to the last date and time for receipt of tenders. The departments shall not be responsible for non accessibility of KPPP portal due to internet connectivity issues and technical glitches at bidders end
Bidder should abide by all the terms and conditions as per uploaded tender document.

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: All IATA approved and registered Air-cargo, Freight Forwarders, Movers who have experience in handling Dangerous Goods by Air. The franchises of Air Cargo Movers can participate in the tendeR
The Freight Forwarders should have moved an individual consignment and consignment weight of minimum 03 MT (Single Shipment).

Freight Forwarders with a minimum average turnover of Rs 50 Lakhs as per annum in any one of the last 3 years are eligible to participate duly supported by Audited statement of Accounts as per Annexure A

tenderTechnicalCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Audited CA Certificate of Annual Turnover
